title: Tree Variational Autoencoders

layout.note: One wide binary tree drawn top-down on white: the root at top centre, ten leaves along the bottom, each with a short down arrow onto a 3x3 image mosaic and a rounded grey pill below; mosaics under deeper leaves hang lower so all arrows have the same length; animals and vehicles pills sit beside the first splits.

lesson: Show a learned hierarchy by drawing the tree itself and hanging a framed mosaic of real samples under every leaf with a one-word pill, so the quality of the grouping can be judged from the pictures alone.
